name: I Am Mechanic: Gas Station VR
summary:
I Am Mechanic: Gas Station VR

The most realistic car mechanic and gas station simulator in virtual reality.

Enter the world of hands-on vehicle repair, VR fuel station management, and mechanic gameplay in this ultra-immersive simulation. Fix cars, refuel vehicles, wash and service them, and run a full auto repair shop as a professional VR mechanic on Meta Quest 2 & 3.

🛠️ What You Can Do in the Game:

🧰 Car Mechanic Simulator VR – Diagnose and fix engines, replace tires, change oil, repair brakes, swap
